title: Uniform Ext bound between constructible sheaves (ring of integers)
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ in which $\ell$ is invertible [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $\Lambda=\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ the condensed ring of its integers [def-sfb-padic-integers-condensed-ring]. Let $X$ be a $k$-scheme whose structure morphism $a_X\colon X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type, let $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ be the pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ the abelian category of $\Lambda_X$-module objects in abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Call $M\in\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ constructible as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible] (there is a finite stratification of $X$ on whose strata $M$ is pro-étale locally finitely presented), and ind-constructible if it is a filtered colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of constructible objects. Assume moreover that $k$ is finite or separably closed. Then for every constructible $M$ there is an integer $d$ such that $\operatorname{Ext}^q(M,B)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})}(M,B[q])=0$ [def-pc-ext] for all $q\ge d$ and all constructible $B$ (in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]).
